bullets.text: Under project supervision, implemented reusable Python modules for the recorded workflow and wrote regression tests with pytest for malformed and edge-case inputs.
Ran supplied NLTK tokenization and frequency-count steps on public policy document samples; inspected frequent terms with guidance using the provided topic-coding guide.

Under project supervision, validated SQL joins with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks and visualized how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules using pandas and Matplotlib.
Within supervised research, wrote Python functions for parsing provided company report records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.

Under research supervision, used regular-expression and dictionary rules to extract organization and date spans from public company report excerpts and compared extracted spans with provided manually checked examples.
Under research supervision, joined document identifiers to metadata using SQL, checked unmatched records, visualized group comparisons with Matplotlib, and documented missing-data handling.
